fields.label: What This Automation Does
fields.description: This automation's effect while it is on, what stands in its place while it is off, and where a user meets it.
The automation's name, read as Area, Subject, Behaviour. It cannot be renamed or created by hand.
fields.label: Automation Key

fields.description: The part of the CRM this automation acts on. Filled in automatically; the list groups by it.
fields.label: Area

fields.description: The trigger that makes it run - a record being saved, a scheduled job, a call to or from an outside service, or a permission check.
fields.label: Fires On
fields.options:
Doc Event
Schedule
Provider call
Permission

fields.description: The exact record and moment that make it run.
fields.label: Trigger Detail

fields.description: The one field an operator owns. Ticked, the automation runs; unticked, it is dormant and standard behaviour applies. The choice survives every deploy.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Its behaviour inside an import or a bulk load. Quiet means it does not run for them, so one import cannot flood every rep; live work is never affected.
fields.label: Bulk Lane

fields.description: The automation this one depends on. It cannot be turned on while that one is off.
fields.label: Requires

fields.description: The background job a scheduled automation runs on. Blank for every other kind.
fields.label: Scheduled Job

fields.description: This automation's effect while it is on, what stands in its place while it is off, and where a user meets it. Maintained in code.
fields.label: Description
